proposal.reason: Main change is transport behavior: new communicator config/env controls (`nChannelsPerNetPeer`, `maxP2pPeers`) are validated, propagated across ranks, and used to compute/cap P2P per-peer channel allocation for remote peers and transport setup. `enqueue` is additionally required because `graphUsageMode` now substantively changes strong-stream graph/non-graph mixing and capture handling in work upload/capture paths, not just mechanical parameter threading.
